entities.name: Access Barring Check Procedure
entities.description: Performs access barring check for an access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers or RRC layer.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Identifies the category of access attempt for which barring check is performed.

entities.name: Access Identities
entities.description: One or more identities associated with the access attempt for barring check.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is connected to the network.

entities.name: PCell Change
entities.description: Condition where the UE changes its primary cell in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: Defer Access Barring Checks
entities.description: UE behavior to postpone access barring checks until SIB1 is obtained from target cell after PCell change.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: System information block containing essential cell access parameters.

relations.description: Access barring check procedure is performed for a specific Access Category.
Access barring check procedure is performed for one or more Access Identities.
PCell change in RRC_CONNECTED state establishes the requirement to defer access barring checks.
Deferring access barring checks requires obtaining SIB1 from the target cell.
PCell change occurs when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
